detail.name: Evidence-generating opposition
detail.mechanism: Independent builders and critics produce source-linked causal alternatives and a discriminating test.
detail.solves: Auditable comparison and explicit test hypotheses.
detail.merely_reframes: Does not establish better actual outcomes.

Added work unjustified by named uncertainty

detail.name: Explicit disposition and decision rights
detail.mechanism: Named owner advances, eliminates or defers proposals by a predeclared evidence rule; independent alternative owner can veto mechanism duplication.
detail.procedure: Unsupported -> missing evidence; contradicted -> eliminate; feasible unresolved competitors -> tie and one discriminating test.
detail.merely_reframes: May not discover hidden causes without further investigation.

detail.name: Remove unnecessary intervention obligation
detail.mechanism: Remove mandatory production of another workflow; use smallest decisive source and select bounded observation or no additional mechanism when the premise is absent.
detail.procedure: Direct inspection -> coverage check -> direct disposition or named escalation trigger.
detail.solves: Narrow decisive claims and avoidance of unsupported new work.
detail.merely_reframes: Doing less does not resolve a surviving causal contradiction.
eliminate_if: Direct inspection leaves a named required contradiction unresolved
detail.authorization_boundary: Does not skip the current user-requested execution of all sixteen strategies.
